tour.hotkeyIntro: KeepItLocal's most useful features live behind a few global hotkeys — they work from anywhere in Windows, even when KeepItLocal itself is in the background.
tour.quickSearchLabel: Find files, run system commands, do math, open tools — all from one search box.
tour.clipboardHistoryLabel: Recall anything you've copied recently. Press Enter to paste straight into the app you were just in.
tour.voiceCommandsLabel: Speak to open apps, search, or dictate text — hands-free. Rebind this in Settings → Voice.
tour.dontShowAgainTooltip: If unchecked, the tour will reappear next launch
tour.step1Body: KeepItLocal lives on your machine — nothing you copy, search, or process ever leaves it. No cloud accounts, no telemetry, no background uploads. Just a small set of tools that feel like they should've been built into Windows.
tour.step1Footnote: You can replay this tour anytime from Settings → Onboarding & Tips.
tour.step2Body: Press the shortcut below anywhere in Windows to open the search overlay. Find files by name or content, do math, run system commands, use bang shortcuts (g, gh, yt) — all from one input. The index is local; queries never hit a server.
tour.step3Body: Press the shortcut below to summon your clipboard history. Press ↵ to paste straight into the app you were just in — no Alt-Tabbing. Captures text and (if you opt in) images, including animated GIFs from File Explorer.
tour.step4Title: Voice Commands — speak instead of type
tour.step4Body: Press the shortcut below to open the voice overlay from anywhere. Say "open chrome", "search …", or just dictate text — it's transcribed on-device by Vosk, no cloud calls. Rebind this hotkey anytime in Settings → Voice.
tour.step5Title: Pin what matters · ignore what doesn't
tour.step5Body: Pin reusable snippets (email signatures, API tokens, regex patterns) so they survive cleanup. Sensitive content like API keys and credit-card numbers gets flagged so you never accidentally paste one into chat. Exclude password managers from capture entirely.
tour.step5Footnote: Categories (URL, JSON, code, email…) are auto-detected on every copy.
tour.step6Title: All your data lives on your disk
tour.step6Body: Clipboard history and settings use local app storage; your search index stays on this device too. You can browse the exact path in Settings → Local storage, back it up, copy it to another machine, or wipe it. Optional downloads only run when you choose them.
tour.step6Footnote: Need help? Settings → Documentation has the full guide.
